scenarios.task: Build a small public fixture website with stated behavior and accessibility requirements.
scenarios.success: Independent rendered behavior and acceptance checks pass with preserved source/evidence.
scenarios.fault: Lost stream and stale browser target.

scenarios.task: Repair a sourced reproducible defect with a known oracle and regression set.
scenarios.success: Defect fixed, regressions pass, escaped defects and full correction cost assessed.
scenarios.fault: False-positive test or failed initial repair.

scenarios.task: Refactor a public fixture with dirty index/untracked work and a controlled interruption.
scenarios.success: Original work preserved, derived lineage coherent, behavior verified after resume.
scenarios.fault: Concurrent edit, Stop, session loss or update.

scenarios.task: Complete planning through independent review/recovery using only eligible upstream harness sessions.
scenarios.success: No direct API dependency; every reasoning/helper call and whole-workflow pool accounted.
scenarios.fault: Quota exhaustion, unavailable helper and absent API credentials.

scenarios.task: Answer a fixed public evidence question with primary retrieval through browser/MCP and a versioned citation rubric.
scenarios.success: Claims supported, contrary evidence retained, links/versions valid, blind quality and review cost measured.
scenarios.fault: Stale source, omitted contradiction, incompatible plugin or unavailable comparator.

trials.question: Can supported rich interfaces satisfy the ten controls and all-role closure?
trials.baseline: Direct use of the same frozen harness/interface on one public disposable fixture.
treatments: Canonical broker adapter with SDK/server/ACP/extensions; native loop is a future separately constructed comparator.
trials.unit: One unique fixture task × route/host configuration; attempts and controls nested within it.
workload: Begin with the seven critical names and both Cursor paths. Detect ownership/path/digest and inspect supported schema without login or model invocation; then separately authorize a disposable controlled probe.

Probe one identity/stream/control case per route, prioritizing source counterexamples: Cursor SDK resume settings and whole-turn retry; Grok native question/compact/interjection; Gemini internal-core versus ACP; Claude streaming receipts; OpenCode in-memory questions; Hermes auxiliary routing.
At most two route/host cases in a 30-minute discovery probe. Expand Windows/Linux cases only after a discriminating success or failure; do not execute the full Cartesian product.

Upstream-only fixture removes direct API credentials and requires planning, implementation, independent review, compaction, consultation and recovery, including automatic classifiers/title/token helpers.

trials.question: Which continuation strategy preserves intent and lowers total correction cost?
trials.baseline: Fresh-session deterministic capsule with retained source evidence; direct engine native continuation as second baseline.
treatments: Native-only, deterministic-only and coordinated hybrid compaction; warm affinity versus reconstruction; keepalive is optional experimental treatment.
trials.unit: Unique task and controlled handoff boundary; compaction cycles nested within task.
workload: Use four source-grounded tasks: two interrupted refactors, one upstream-only and one research workflow. Each contains known directive changes, pending question, dirty artifacts and explicit evidence references.
Run cold, warm and no-future-work counterfactuals; route/model/config changes and revoked instructions must invalidate stale memory even if a cache hit would improve.
Exercise two compaction boundaries and a session-loss boundary per task. Keep original evidence/intent for blind comparison; do not persist hidden reasoning.
Measure cache read/write only where exposed; subscription quota stays separate. Count refreshes, failed compaction, hydration, verification and downstream correction.

trials.question: Which minimal formal boundary captures the required races before choosing implementation technology?
trials.baseline: The six existing M1 obligations and frozen regression vectors; no runtime performance baseline inferred.
treatments: Smallest aggregate plus bounded broker refinement versus bounded broker in the first model; then identical CPython/Rust/Go and JSONL/CAS versus SQLite-WAL/CAS comparisons only after their prerequisites.
trials.unit: One bounded state-space configuration or language/store replay workload; traces are not independent productivity samples.
workload: Before formal freeze, include effect projection, separate fence namespaces, single writer, immediate current PAUSE, partition ambiguity, bounded broker flow/replay; add consultation, revision, fork, update and cumulative budget traces.

Initial proposed bounds: two assistants, two tasks, two hosts, queue capacity two, two epochs, one unresolved effect and one update candidate. Enumerate schedules, state bounds and liveness fairness explicitly.
Run a later approved model under both boundaries, compare counterexample coverage and state explosion; a cut-down model never certifies production liveness.

After formal vectors freeze, compare CPython/Rust/Go with identical semantics/faults/build settings on Windows/Linux. Only after language comparison, compare complete JSONL/CAS and SQLite-WAL/CAS stores, including metadata/artifacts/WAL/GC/replay/crash/backup.

trials.question: Can six update modes preserve newest work and enforce credible relative recovery caps?
trials.baseline: Hold/wait on the current verified release with canonical history retained.
treatments: Verified compatible rollback, repair-forward, component isolation and separate-instance restoration under each chosen update mode.
trials.unit: One release/failure schedule and task-budget scope; repeated failures share the same ledger.
workload: Define current tasks by admission sequence, everything by owned scope/epoch and lands by activated version/state receipts. Cover all six modes and three Stops using a bounded state machine, then discriminating implementation fault probes.
Inject pre-stage failure, missing old slot, signature/hash/expiry failure, activation crash, incompatible schema, post-update regression, remote acceptance timeout and returning stale worker.

Use exact rational fractions. Test zero/unknown prior use, delayed counters, repeated shutdown, provider reset, shared pools, multiple currencies and outstanding reservations. No current campaign provider call is authorized.
Report working executable, readable history, newest artifacts and task resumability separately. Check human ability to identify hold/unknown/partial landing and next safe action.
Compare normal checkpoint/telemetry overhead and recovery action/verification/wait costs; a successful reboot alone fails acceptance.
